summary: Always send the os (offset) query parameter, including its zero value, instead of omitting it when it equals zero.
reason: The product-tile endpoint ProductSubcategoryItemTemplate.aspx requires os=0 to return the first page. The generator's default emission guards int params with a non-zero check, so the first page of every category came back with zero products and no error — a silent empty result rather than a failure. Sending the zero value unconditionally is what makes catalog product paging work from offset 0.
validated_outcome: sync walks 69 categories and stores 2022 products; without this the first page of each category returned nothing.
